title: Seven JSON-LD Nodes, Zero Facts
hook: We found seven JSON-LD nodes and extracted zero facts.
thesis: Structured markup present is not the same as facts extracted. The directive's own falsification stories include the @graph case: @graph existed but the flattener ignored it, so extraction silently produced nothing. The episode generalizes the lesson: extraction pipelines must verify what they captured against what the source contained, and 'found markup' is an observation, not evidence of facts. It ends with the regression: the fixture that failed before recursive processing and passes after.

proven: The directive lists the @graph falsification: @graph existed but the flattener ignored it (section 2).
The directive cites the @graph fixture as the canonical RED TEST to PATCH to GREEN TEST example (section 22).
partial: The current flattener behavior on the cited fixture.
unknown: Whether the real site or fixture may be named publicly. A second extraction-gap example.
